scripts.clean: powershell -Command "@(5173,8765) | ForEach-Object { $port=$_; $procId=(Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $port -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).OwningProcess; if($procId){Stop-Process -Id $procId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host \"Killed port $port (PID $procId)\"} else {Write-Host \"Port $port is free\"} }"
scripts.start: npm run clean && cd frontend && npm run start:all
